## 1. Purpose

This Addendum responds to items identified in NREOCRC-OPR-001 Section 20.2 as requiring confirmation prior to the Proposal Submission Deadline. It amends the OPR as set out below. Except as expressly amended, all other provisions of NREOCRC-OPR-001 remain unchanged and in full force.

## 2. Amendment to Section 6.1 (Accessibility)

Section 6.1 is amended by replacing the phrase "incorporated by reference (see Section 3; full citation to be confirmed in the Data Room Document Register)" with the following:

"incorporated by reference. Full citation: *City of North River Accessibility Design Standard, 2023 Edition, as amended by City Council By-law 2025-114*, available through the City of North River Clerk's Office. This citation supersedes the placeholder in NREOCRC-DR-001 pending that document's issuance."

## 3. Amendment to Section 19.3 (Record Documentation Format)

Section 19.3 is amended by replacing "to be confirmed at the RFP stage" with:

"in the City of North River standard CAFM-compatible record-documentation format (COBie-aligned data schema); the Design-Builder shall confirm compatibility of proposed record-documentation tools with the City's current CAFM platform during the Commissioning Plan development."

## 4. No Other Change

No other Section of NREOCRC-OPR-001 is amended by this Addendum. This Addendum does not amend Section 12 (Standby Power Requirements) or Appendix OPR-1 (Functional Program).
